ModMetaData.name: Center Frill North Fix — Vanilla Races Expanded: Saurid
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Restores the north-facing art of the "littlefoot" center frill in Vanilla Races Expanded - Saurid.
The art is not missing and it is not broken. The north texture ships complete inside the donor mod — it is simply saved with a stray trailing hyphen in its filename, "CenterFrill8_north-.png", so the game never finds it. RimWorld's Graphic_Multi silently falls back to the south texture when a direction is absent, so a saurid with this frill shows the FRONT of its head-crest while facing away from you.
No defs are patched, no code runs, and Vanilla Races Expanded - Saurid is not altered. This mod ships the donor's own bytes, unmodified, at the filename its own HairDef already asks for.
CONTENTS
Pawn/CenterFrill/CenterFrill8_north The north facing of the littlefoot frill. 128x128, 1,051 bytes, byte-for-byte the donor's own Textures/Pawn/CenterFrill/ CenterFrill8_north-.png. Nothing was redrawn, re-encoded or resized.
WHERE THE TYPO IS
Vanilla Races Expanded - Saurid's own HairDef asks for the unhyphenated path:
1.6/Defs/HairDefs/HairDefs_Saurid.xml line 68 defName VRESaurids_Littlefoot line 70 texPath Pawn/CenterFrill/CenterFrill8
CenterFrill8 is the only one of the eleven frills affected. Its own _east and _south are named correctly, and every sibling set — CenterFrill through CenterFrill10, notably CenterFrill7 right beside it — ships a clean "CenterFrillN_north.png". CenterFrill7_north.png is the naming pattern this file was copied to.
The defect cannot appear in the log. "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when EVERY direction of a Graphic_Multi is missing; one absent direction is a silent fallback.
LOAD ORDER MATTERS HERE
Vanilla Races Expanded - Saurid ships all of its art as loose PNGs — the mod contains no AssetBundles at all. Between two loose files at the same path RimWorld resolves by load order, so this mod must load AFTER the donor. That is the opposite of an AssetBundle override, where a loose file wins regardless of order.
If Vanilla Races Expanded - Saurid ever corrects the filename upstream, this mod becomes a harmless no-op that supplies the same bytes, and can be unsubscribed.
